opportunity.title: Scalable GEOINT Architecture IT Contractor Manpower Equivalent (CME) Support
opportunity.description: Request for Proposal W50NH9-27-R-A006 for Scalable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT) Architecture IT Contractor Manpower Equivalent support for U.S. Army Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM). Proposals due Nov 13, 2026 with a proposal validity of at least 240 days. Period of performance: one 30-day transition-in, a 12-month base, four 12-month options and one six-month option. Estimated award date Jan 11, 2027. Primarily time and materials, evaluated on a best value trade-off basis.

rationale.point: Company has no prior DoD prime contracts and past performance limited to state/local projects under $500K each, while the opportunity involves DoD GEOINT work at a scale indicated by a $32.7M comparable contract (claim #3).
Contract is time-and-materials (claim #2), posing cost overrun risk; company lacks experience managing T&M contracts and has no SOC 2 report or facility clearance to mitigate oversight.

No small-business set-aside for this opportunity (set-aside NONE) means full-and-open competition against large incumbents like CACI (claim #3), while company has only six engineers and no facility clearance.

risks: Cost overruns on T&M contract without strong management experience (claim #2)
Insufficient past performance for DoD GEOINT scope (claims #1, #3)
Lack of facility clearance likely required for GEOINT work
Team of six engineers inadequate for probable scale (claim #3 indicates multi-million dollar effort)
Full-and-open competition against large, experienced contractors
nextSteps: Target DoD opportunities with small-business set-asides matching NAICS 541519
Build past performance via subcontracting on GEOINT-related efforts
Pursue facility clearance and SOC 2 certification to meet DoD requirements
Consider teaming with a prime contractor as a subcontractor for similar work
